items.text_en: Never the same family in the same bed twice running. The monthly rebuild forces this by itself.
items.text_hr: Nikad ista porodica dvaput zaredom u istoj gredici. Mjesečna obnova to sama nameće.

items.text_en: Water only what the plant needs. Excess water is what draws most of the pests in.
items.text_hr: Zalijevaj samo koliko biljci treba. Višak vode je ono što privuče većinu nametnika.

items.text_en: Keep one permanent bed of sage, rosemary, lavender and local herbs. It feeds the insects that eat the aphids.
items.text_hr: Drži jednu trajnu gredicu kadulje, ružmarina, lavande i domaćeg bilja. Ona hrani kukce koji jedu lisne uši.

items.text_en: Plant twenty to thirty per cent more than you need. That surplus is the price of not spraying, and it is cheaper than spraying.
items.text_hr: Posadi dvadeset do trideset posto više nego što ti treba. Taj višak je cijena neprskanja, i jeftiniji je od prskanja.

items.text_en: Losses run around five per cent. Weeds under a standing crop can stay, they lift nutrients from deeper down and the next shallow tilling returns them.
items.text_hr: Gubici su oko pet posto. Korov ispod uspravne kulture može ostati, on diže hranjiva iz dubine, a sljedeća plitka obrada ih vraća.
